title: Matt Blumberg — 'Book Short: Incorruptible, right and timely and inspiring and depressing all at the same time'
summary: Matt Blumberg — author of Startup CEO, Startup CXO, and Startup Boards, and back-of-book endorser — publishes a long-form LinkedIn Pulse review of Incorruptible, calling it a new MUST READ for founders and investors and arguing that the world Eric paints is utterly compatible with hard-core capitalist principles.
blockquote: But the world he paints — one in which companies can achieve superior long-term results for shareholders AND also for customers and employees — is not as hard as it might seem, and it's utterly compatible with hard-core capitalist principles.
blockquote_source: Matt Blumberg, 'Book Short: Incorruptible' on LinkedIn Pulse
attribution_title: CEO of Markup AI; author of Startup CEO, Startup CXO, and Startup Boards
